info.name: Social Inbox Automation API
info.description:
Postman collection for the NestJS backend (clients, business info, offers, services, users, auth, n8n callback and Meta webhooks).

## Getting started
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:3000`).
2. Run **Auth → Login** (set `userEmail` first). The token is saved to `accessToken` automatically.
3. Every other request inherits **Bearer {{accessToken}}** from the collection, except those marked *No Auth* (auth, n8n callback, Meta webhooks).
4. Create requests save ids into `clientId`, `offerId`, `serviceId`, `resourceId` where applicable. Requests using `:id` use `{{resourceId}}`: copy the relevant id into it.

## Variables
| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | API root |
| `accessToken` | JWT (auto-filled on login) |
| `userEmail` | Email for login / user lookup |
| `clientId`, `offerId`, `serviceId`, `resourceId` | Resource ids |
| `n8nWebhookSecret` | Must equal server `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` |
| `metaVerifyToken` | Must equal server webhook verify token |
| `metaAppSecret` | Meta app secret used to sign webhook payloads |
| `pageId`, `igAccountId` | Ids used in sample webhook payloads |

## Notes
- Request body schemas (Zod DTOs) were not provided, so example bodies are illustrative. Adjust them to your schemas.
- Roles: `PUT /clients/:id/access-token` and `POST /inbox/comments/backfill` enforce `ADMIN` via `RolesGuard`.

item.name: n8n Callback
item.description:
Server-to-server callback invoked by the n8n workflow after the AI reply is generated. **No JWT.** Authenticated by the `x-webhook-secret` header, which must equal the `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env var.

The server looks up the pending request by `id` (`N8nDeliveryService.take`). If the id is unknown/duplicate/expired the response is `{ acknowledged: false }`. Replies are sent asynchronously (fire-and-forget).

request.description:
Used when the pending request is of kind `batch` (direct messages). Only `id` and `text` are used. Empty/blank `text` sends nothing.

**Responses:** `200 {acknowledged:true}` | `200 {acknowledged:false}` (duplicate/expired) | `400` missing id | `401` bad secret

Used when the pending request is a comment. `type` must be `engagement` or `question` (defaults to `engagement`).

For `engagement`, typically `publicReply` is used.

body.raw:
{
  "id": "pending-request-id",
  "type": "question",
  "dmText": "Our opening hours are 8am-11pm daily.",
  "publicReplyIfDmSent": "Sent you a DM with the details!",
  "publicReplyIfDmClosed": "Please message us directly and we'll help right away."
}

request.description:
For `question` comments: send a DM and a public reply that depends on whether the DM could be delivered.

- `dmText`: private message text
- `publicReplyIfDmSent`: public reply if the DM was sent
- `publicReplyIfDmClosed`: public reply if the DM window is closed
Negative test: wrong secret returns 401.

item.name: Inbox
item.description: Inbox operations. Requires JWT with the `ADMIN` role (`RolesGuard`).

request.description:
Replies to the comments on a post that the page never answered (replaces the Telegram "reply to old comments" n8n workflow).

Fetches the post's top-level comments, keeps the ones that are not from the page, not hidden and have no reply from the page, then feeds them newest first into the inbox, one every `COMMENT_BACKFILL_DELAY_MS` (default 5000). Each one goes through the normal comment flow: classifier, Gemini if unsure, then reply / DM / like / hide.

**Requires:** `ADMIN` role (returns 403 otherwise).

**Body:** `{ "accountId": string, "postId": string }`
- `accountId`: Facebook Page ID or Instagram account ID. The platform is taken from the client that owns it.
- `postId`: Facebook post ID (`{pageId}_{postId}`) or Instagram media ID.

**Responses:**
- `202` `{ platform, postId, total, pending, delaySeconds }`: the run continues in the background.
- `404` no client owns `accountId`; `400` the client has no access token; `409` a run is already in progress for this post.
- Meta errors (`details` has Meta's `graphCode` / `graphSubcode`):
  - `404 META_POST_NOT_FOUND`: the post isn't on this page or the token can't see it. Use the `post_id` from a comment webhook.
  - `400 META_TOKEN_INVALID`: the client's token is expired or revoked.
  - `400 META_PERMISSION_DENIED`: the token is missing a permission.
  - `503 META_UNAVAILABLE`: Meta is down; try again later.
  - `502 META_ERROR`: any other Meta rejection.

item.name: Meta Webhooks
item.description:
Webhook endpoint for Meta (Facebook Pages + Instagram). **No JWT.**

- `GET` is the subscription verification handshake.
- `POST` receives events and is verified via `x-hub-signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256 of the **raw body** with the app secret). The requests below compute the signature automatically in a pre-request script using the `metaAppSecret` variable.

Events are processed asynchronously; the endpoint always answers `200 {received:true}` once the signature is valid.

query.description: Must match the server's verify token

request.description: Meta's verification challenge. Returns `hub.challenge` as plain text if `hub.verify_token` matches the server's configured token.
Simulates a Facebook Page event (`object: page`) routed to `MetaWebhookService.handleEvent`. Example: an incoming Messenger message.
Simulates a Facebook Page feed comment event (`object: page`, `changes` with `field: feed`).
Simulates an Instagram event (`object: instagram`) routed to `InstagramWebhookService.handleEvent`.
Simulates an Instagram comment event (`changes` with `field: comments`).
Negative test: sends a wrong signature. The exact status depends on `MetaWebhookService.verifySignature` (typically 401/403).
